preconditions.description: Number of nodes in the tree.
Maximum allowed distance between the two pieces.
Number of edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Nodes in edges are within the valid range.
Length of the first piece's sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n for a in sequence1)
preconditions.description: Nodes in the first piece's sequence are within the valid range.
Length of the second piece's sequence.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= n for b in sequence2)
preconditions.description: Nodes in the second piece's sequence are within the valid range.

postconditions.expression: all(distance(a, b) <= d for a, b in zip(sequence1, sequence2))
postconditions.description: Distance between the two pieces does not exceed d during their journey.
Both pieces return to the root node.
